title: The pointer is resent only when the agent went ready again without acking
action: hps-3 left `deliver_pointer` (run.rs:895) resending the pointer on a fixed tick, and that tick is far too fast for a real worker. Today: `AGENT_PROMPT_TIMEOUT_MS` is 5000 and the loop sleeps `POLL_INTERVAL` (200ms) between attempts, so resend 2 fires about 5.2s after resend 1 and resend 3 about 10.4s after it — while a healthy worker is still reading a ten-kilobyte brief and has not written its ack yet. Every one of those resends is `herdr agent prompt` typing the pointer into an agent that IS working, where it queues as another user message and makes the worker re-read the brief. The bound is also the whole delivery budget: ten attempts is roughly 52 seconds, after which a perfectly healthy but slow first turn is failed as `NeverAcked`. Fix the CADENCE, not the decisions — D1, D3 and D4 all stay exactly as they are. New shape: after a send herdr reports successful, POLL for the ack instead of resending. In that poll, the round's ack file or result file appearing is delivery (`Ok`); a `blocked` status ends it at once (`DeliveryError::Blocked`, D3); a `working` status is the HEALTHY path and must NOT trigger a resend — keep polling; and only when the agent has gone back to a ready state (`idle` or `done`, per D2's vocabulary) with still no ack does the pointer get resent, because that is the actual signature of a submission the TUI dropped. Bound the whole thing two ways: keep a resend attempt bound in the house style, and add a named wall-clock ack-wait budget generous enough for a slow first turn — well under the idle timeout, and stated in its doc comment as being about how long a first agent turn takes, not about how fast a poll ticks. Exhausting either bound is still `DeliveryError::NeverAcked`, and its message should name which bound ran out. Use the same injected `sleep`/`now` seams the other loops use so the tests need no real clock. Tests: a working agent polled to an ack with EXACTLY ONE send; an agent that returns to idle without acking getting a resend; a blocked status mid-poll ending at once; `agent_prompt_stalled` still failing fast; the ack-wait budget expiring as NeverAcked; and the existing hps-3 cases kept green.

truths: A worker that is working and has not acked yet receives exactly one pointer send, never a resend
A resend happens only when the agent returned to idle or done with no ack
A blocked status and agent_prompt_stalled still end the delivery at once
The delivery budget is a named wall-clock ack window sized for a slow first agent turn, not a byproduct of the resend tick

artifacts.substantive: ready-gated resend with a named ack-wait budget, its doc comment, and the tests above; no TODO stubs

key_links: the resend decision reads the agent status, not a timer
prohibitions: No change to D1, D3 or D4 semantics — the receipt stays the ack or result file
No reintroduction of a lifecycle state as the delivery success signal
Do not drop the result_present() escape
